description: Builds the USDC transfer of the Check price from payer to the analysis fee wallet on chainId, for the payer to sign. Needs access, the Check access of this payer (check_access); without it, or with the access of another wallet, check_payer_proof_required (401). Returns { check { id, status awaiting_payment, amount, amountRaw, token, feeWallet }, transaction, plan (buildId check-<id>, steps on EVM or transaction on Solana), report }. Sign the transaction exactly as returned: it carries the mark of THIS Check (16 bytes after the transfer arguments on EVM, a memo on Solana). A transfer you build yourself is refused with analysis_payment_rejected reason charge_not_tied after the money left: do not pay again, prove the wallet with destination_challenge (receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = the check id, chargeTxHash = that hash) and destination_authorize, then report the same hash again. Calling again before paying returns the same open Check. Refusals: analysis_tool_unavailable (503, a tool is down: nothing is built), check_credit_limit (409), payer_blocked (403), check_network_unsupported (400), check_unavailable (503).

access.description: The Check access of this payer from check_access (vca_...). Secret: it reads and spends this payer's credits.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

payer.description: The paying wallet (0x on EVM, base58 on Solana).

name: check_charge
